text: Thank you for those details. text: My main symptom is Aggressive cough with thick, yellow-green sputum. I also have Cough worse in the morning, History of recurrent bronchitis.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Bronchiectasis. The clinical picture of a non-smoker with an 11-year history of chronic, productive cough with thick, purulent sputum (worse in the morning) and recurrent bronchitis is classic for this condition.
